seo.title: Nuku'alofa homeless help - No Home Help
seo.description: Verified shelter, food, health, safety, legal and social support for people experiencing homelessness in Nuku'alofa.

page.heading: NUKU'ALOFA - HOMELESS HELP
page.urgent: Immediate danger: contact Tonga Police. Violence or safe housing: Women and Children Crisis Centre 0800 444. Medical emergency: Vaiola Hospital.
page.notice: Information and availability can change. Call before travelling when possible. A listing does not guarantee a bed, meal, appointment, benefit, treatment or job.
page.intro: There is no published general walk-in homeless shelter in Nuku'alofa. Women and children escaping violence can contact WCCC for safe housing. The Salvation Army explicitly states that it does not provide accommodation locally, but it can provide emergency food, clothing, health outreach and other support.
page.footer: Main sources: Women and Children Crisis Centre Tonga, Salvation Army Tonga, Tonga Ministry of Health and Public Service Commission.

entries.title: Women and Children Crisis Centre
entries.description: Free, confidential 24-hour crisis intervention, safety planning, counselling, advocacy and safe-housing support for survivors of violence and discrimination.
entries.address: Taufa'ahau Road, Tungi Colonnade Building, Nuku'alofa
entries.how_to_access: Call 0800 444. Use police if there is immediate danger.

entries.title: Salvation Army Regional Community Ministries
entries.description: Emergency food parcels, clothing, a mobile health clinic, addiction counselling and other welfare support. The organisation states that it does not offer accommodation in Nuku'alofa.
entries.address: Mosimani Building, corner Hala Fatafehi and Mateialona, Nuku'alofa
entries.how_to_access: Call before visiting and explain what help is needed.

entries.title: WCCC safe housing
entries.description: Confidential refuge and safe-housing support for survivors of violence. Placement depends on safety assessment and space.
entries.how_to_access: Call the toll-free helpline. Do not travel to a confidential refuge without referral.

entries.title: Salvation Army emergency food parcels
entries.description: Emergency food parcels for people and families in hardship, subject to assessment and supplies.
entries.address: Mosimani Building, corner Hala Fatafehi and Mateialona, Nuku'alofa
entries.how_to_access: Call first to confirm availability and what information to bring.

entries.title: Nuku'alofa Salvation Army
entries.description: Christian community service providing welfare, food, clothing, health outreach, addiction counselling and court or prison visitation.
entries.hours: Contact the corps or Community Ministries
entries.how_to_access: Call for practical assistance; religious participation is not listed as a condition for welfare support.

entries.title: Salvation Army clothing support
entries.description: Emergency clothing and donated goods may be available through Regional Community Ministries.
entries.address: Mosimani Building, corner Hala Fatafehi and Mateialona, Nuku'alofa

entries.title: Vaiola Hospital
entries.description: Main referral hospital on Tongatapu and the appropriate destination for urgent medical care.
entries.how_to_access: Go to the emergency department for urgent care.

entries.title: Salvation Army mobile health clinic
entries.description: Mobile clinic serving Popua and Patangata on alternating weeks. Contact Community Ministries to confirm the current location and date.
entries.how_to_access: Call before travelling to learn which location is operating.

entries.title: Alcohol and Drug Awareness Centre
entries.description: Salvation Army counselling, assessment and education relating to alcohol, drugs, HIV, anger management and life skills.
entries.address: Mosimani Building, corner Hala Fatafehi and Mateialona, Nuku'alofa
entries.how_to_access: Call Community Ministries for an assessment or appointment.

entries.title: Tonga Public Service Commission
entries.description: Official public-service vacancies and information about applying for government employment. Vacancies and requirements change.
entries.hours: Online information and government office hours
entries.how_to_access: Check current vacancies and follow the application instructions for each post.

entries.title: Women and Children Crisis Centre Tonga
entries.description: Counselling, advocacy, crisis intervention, practical grants and confidential safe housing for survivors of violence.
entries.address: Taufa'ahau Road, Tungi Colonnade Building, Nuku'alofa
entries.how_to_access: Call 0800 444 for crisis help or +676 22 240 for the office.
